technology_assessment.note: Hantec's Asia-localized trading-tools page runs a dedicated Trading Central section describing investment research, technical analysis and trading signals.

VERY STRONG, high-confidence Acuity Trading integration - a live embedded 'AcuityAnalysisIQ' market-data/news widget with its own CDN domain (acuitycdn.azureedge.net) and news attribution 'By Acuity' visible on the homepage. This is exactly the kind of domain/widget evidence FIX #2 was designed to catch - the vendor's own CDN subdomain appears throughout image src attributes even though 'Acuity Trading' as a full company name is not spelled out verbatim (only 'Acuity' / 'acuity-widget' / 'AcuityAnalysisIQ' / 'acuitycdn'). Distinct from 'HANTEC FINANCIAL' (hantec.com) elsewhere in this batch, which instead shows a Trading Central integration - these appear to be two different sites/brands under the Hantec name.
